ownerResponseText:
Dear Ahmet,

Thank you for visiting our restaurant and taking the time to share your experience.

We are very sorry to hear that you felt unwell after your visit. We sincerely wish you a speedy and full recovery.

However, after careful review, we cannot find any connection to our restaurant. During the same period, we received no other reports of similar complaints from other guests. Furthermore, our staff regularly eat the same ramen and ingredients that we serve our guests without any health problems.

Therefore, we regret to inform you that we cannot assume your symptoms were caused by our food.

We take food safety very seriously and always adhere to strict hygiene and quality standards. Should you wish to share any further information with us, please feel free to contact us directly.

Sincerely,
ownerResponseOriginalText:
Sehr geehrter Ahmet,

vielen Dank, dass Sie unser Restaurant besucht haben und sich die Zeit genommen haben, Ihre Erfahrung zu teilen.

Es tut uns sehr leid zu hören, dass es Ihnen nach Ihrem Besuch gesundheitlich nicht gut ging. Wir wünschen Ihnen aufrichtig eine schnelle und vollständige Genesung.

Nach sorgfältiger Prüfung können wir jedoch keinen Zusammenhang mit unserem Restaurant feststellen. Im gleichen Zeitraum haben wir keine weiteren Meldungen über ähnliche Beschwerden von anderen Gästen erhalten. Außerdem essen unsere Mitarbeiter regelmäßig dieselben Ramen und Zutaten, die wir unseren Gästen servieren, ohne gesundheitliche Probleme.

Aus diesem Grund können wir leider nicht davon ausgehen, dass Ihre Beschwerden durch unsere Speisen verursacht wurden.

Wir nehmen die Lebensmittelsicherheit sehr ernst und arbeiten stets nach strengen Hygiene- und Qualitätsstandards. Sollten Sie weitere Informationen mit uns teilen möchten, können Sie uns jederzeit direkt kontaktieren.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen

text: A stylish restaurant with a small, select seasonal menu, a departure from the mainstream of other restaurants. A refreshing change of pace from the culinary scene, and certainly worth a visit. The welcome was very friendly, and I was immediately shown to a freshly set table. However, I had to wait what felt like forever before I could place an order. This feeling persisted for the next two hours, while other guests were served more attentively and quickly. The menu was rather limited; I would have liked more variety, especially in terms of main courses. The steak tartare appetizer, prepared with very coarsely chopped pieces, was hidden under a layer of chips, which I found rather unsuitable as a side dish. The wild boar sausage with the lentils, on the other hand, was a real hit and highly recommended. Overall, however, due to the high prices, I can only give it an average rating. The selection and portion sizes of the dishes, as well as the service, definitely have room for improvement.
originalText: Stylisches Restaurant mit kleiner, ausgewählter saisonaler Karte abseits des Mainstreams anderer Gastronomiebetriebe. Mal etwas anderes aus der kulinarischen Ecke, und das ist sicherlich einen Besuch wert. Die Begrüßung war sehr freundlich, ich bekam direkt einen frisch eingedeckten Tisch zugewiesen, musste allerdings gefühlte Ewigkeiten warten, bis ich eine Bestellung aufgeben konnte. Und dieses Gefühl zog sich dann die nächsten zwei Stunden weiter durch, andere Gäste wurden hingegen zuvorkommender und schneller bedient. Die Speisekarte war eher überschaubar, ich hätte mir gerne mehr Auswahl, vor allem an Hauptspeisen, gewünscht. Das Tartare als Vorspeise, eher sehr grob gehackt zubereitet, versteckte sich unter einem Mantel an Chips, die mir als Beilage geschmacklich eher ungeeignet erschienen. Die Wildbratwurst mit den Tellerlinsen hingegen war ein echter Hit, sehr empfehlenswert. Insgesamt jedoch auch auf Grund der hohen Preise nur eine durchschnittliche Bewertung meinerseits, die Auswahl und Größe der Speisen sowie der Service haben noch "Luft nach oben".

text:
At previous visits to Berlin the restaurant was closed, perhaps for good I thought. I was pleasantly surprised when on this trip I discovered the place being open again.  Perhaps it is under new management, so I’m not paying attention to old reviews.

The room with a long bar and some single and communal tables was buzzing and the young and vibrant staff had apparently everything under control.
The menu is concise and covers all bases, so does the beverage list.
Weissburgunder, Grüner Veltliner were tasty. Crispy sourdough bread, oysters, veal tongue and as main course mackerel were fantastic.

There are plenty of restaurants in Berlin offering the usual fare, schweine haxen, schnitzel pommes frites etc.  this is not one of them.

This is a refreshingly “new” German restaurant with a farm fresh ever changing menu.  Hurray!

I absolutely cannot recommend this restaurant. It was my biggest dining disappointment in Berlin.

text:
An absolute disaster. I have rarely experienced such terrible service.

There were 30 to 40 minute waits between courses. Throughout the entire evening, we weren't asked once if we wanted anything else to drink. Instead, we had to repeatedly ask the waiters/waitresses ourselves just to order drinks or additional food.

The service was so inattentive that even used cutlery was cleared away and then new dishes were served – without any fresh cutlery. Since the plates were quickly placed on the table each time and the waiters disappeared immediately, we didn't even have the chance to ask for a fork. We practically had to chase after the staff. They literally turned their backs on us every single time, or didn't even properly stand at the table to place the food. In the end, we even received two servings of bread…

My husband even had to go to the bar twice himself to ask again for the aioli that came with our meal and to get fresh cutlery.

The restaurant wasn't even full on a Wednesday at 7 p.m. Such poor organization and disinterested service are no excuse.

The food was okay for the price, but the abysmal service completely ruined it. Items were constantly missing, drinks only arrived after we asked for them, and as a guest, we felt completely ignored.

For the first time, I deliberately didn't leave a tip—and rightly so. A restaurant experience isn't just about the food, but also about the service. Both were a huge disappointment here. We definitely won't be coming back.

If you’re looking for authentic tapas in Kreuzberg, Bar Raval is an excellent choice. Located right next to Görlitzer Park, it’s the perfect place to enjoy Spanish tapas and a glass of wine while soaking up one of Berlin’s most vibrant neighborhoods.

The restaurant offers several comfortable outdoor tables, making it an ideal spot to watch the lively atmosphere around Görlitzer Park especially on warm, sunny evenings.

What makes Bar Raval stand out is its relaxed setting. It’s particularly well suited for groups of friends looking to share a variety of tapas and spend a leisurely evening together. The service was attentive, welcoming, and efficient throughout our visit, adding to the enjoyable experience.

text: We visited this restaurant at lunchtime and ordered beef pho and duck fried rice noodles. Unfortunately, the pho didn't taste authentic. They used some kind of broth and added pho flavoring. I'm Vietnamese and I know what real pho tastes like. The fried rice noodles were way too spicy, tasted only of soy sauce, and were inedible. We returned the dish almost untouched, and my wife ordered a portion of spring rolls instead. There was no apology or any attempt to make it right. We were charged for everything with the explanation that "we spice this dish more because our guests love it." Well, that's just how it is. Luckily, there are plenty of other Vietnamese restaurants in Berlin that are much better.
originalText: Wir hatten dieses Restaurant zu Mittagszeit besucht und hatten Pho mit Rindfleisch und gebratene Reisbandnudeln mit Ente bestellt. Die Pho hatte leider nicht authentisch geschmeckt. Hier wurde irgendeine Brühe verwendet und mit Pho-Flavour nachgewürzt. Ich bin Vietnamese und weiß wie eine richtige Pho schmeckt. Die gebratene Reisbandnudeln waren total überwürzt, hatte nur nach Sojasauce geschmeckt und war ungenießbar. Fast unangetastet gaben wir das Gericht zurück und meine Frau hatte sich stattdessen eine Portion Frühlingsrolle bestellt. Es gab keine Entschuldigung und auch kein entgegenkommen. Uns wurde komplett alles in Rechnung gestellt mit der Begründung „bei uns wird dieses Gericht stärker gewürzt weil unsere Gäste es lieben“. Naja, dann ist es halt so. Zum Glück gibt es in Berlin noch genug andere vietnamesische Restaurants die deutlich besser sind.

text:
Unfortunately, a negative experience. At the end of April 2026, I went there for dinner in the evening. It was sunny, and the restaurant was quiet to moderately busy.

The food was particularly disappointing: I ordered the vegetarian duck with noodles.

The "duck" tasted like deep-fried breading, nothing else. The noodles were completely overcooked and therefore inedible.

My companion ordered the "BBQ tofu dish with rice," which completely lacked any BBQ flavor; no barbecue seasoning or anything like that, which one would expect (for almost €20)!

The rice was okay.

I was very disappointed, which I politely and respectfully expressed. Even the waitress asked about the noodles and said on her own, "They were overcooked, weren't they?"

What can I say? I wouldn't pay anything for a meal like that, and I certainly won't be going back.

I won't even mention the ginger tea with honey (note: Lidl's own brand honey), especially since they didn't bring us the honey at all initially (only after we asked once).

It's a shame; in my opinion, this store is ruining itself with such unappetizing "dishes."

-> die "Ente" schmeckte nach frittierter Panade, sonst nach nichts. Die Nudeln waren total verkocht. Somit ungenießbar.

Ich war sehr enttäuscht, was ich auch freundlich & nett sagte. Sogar die Kellnerin fragte nach wegen der Nudeln und sagte von sich aus "sie waren verkocht, oder"?

Was soll ich dazu sagen; eigentlich würde ich für so ein Essen nichts bezahlen, und hingehen werde ich sowieso nie mehr.

Tee Ingwer mit Honig (Beachte: Honig von Hausmarke Lidl) erwähne ich gar nicht erst, auch weil uns der Honig erst mal überhaupt nicht gebracht wurde (erst nach 1x nachfragen).

Schade, dieser Laden schafft sich aus meiner Sicht selbst ab mit solchen "Gerichten" die nicht schmecken.

text:
Finally found a Sudanese food stall that actually puts in the effort. My first experience with Sudanese fast food was a culinary explosion of flavor. The place was fantastic, but unfortunately, it's now closed. Since then, I've been disappointed time and again. Kartoum is the best I've found in a long time. The portion size is decent, the price isn't exorbitant, and the service is friendly.

Unlike the competition, the peanut sauce was actually good again.

Since I remember it being different, my suggestion for improvement is to season it even better, add a little more salt, and make sure the sauce is spread evenly. Otherwise, it's too soy at first and becomes too dry at the end.

text:

text:
We came to Mastan Berlin with high expectations and left very disappointed. While the service was acceptable and the outdoor seating is pleasant, the food quality was far below standard—especially for the price.
The baguette was clearly not fresh, the tomatoes were served warm, and the €46 steak was extremely salty to the point of being inedible. The cold cuts also did not taste fresh. Despite this, we still paid a €180 bill, which felt completely unjustified.
The only highlight was the wine, which was effectively upsold by the waiter and enjoyable. However, this does not make up for the poor food quality. Berlin offers far better dining experiences at a fraction of the cost. I would not recommend this restaurant for food—at best, it is a place to have a glass of wine outside.

text:
We had seats on the terrace, which was more of a spot in front of the restaurant on the street. Since the street was closed to traffic, the noise level was pleasant.

The seating consisted of very simple wooden folding chairs, the kind you see in old-fashioned restaurants, and the round table was a bit small.

We received a very friendly welcome.

We chose the 300g entrecote steak with fries, as the other four main courses didn't appeal to us.

The fries were homemade and nice and crispy, and the peppercorn sauce we chose was also tasty. I expected more from the steak, especially considering the price of €46. It lacked finesse, and we would have appreciated a more elegant presentation.

The steak sat alone on the plate and, without any garnish, looked rather unappealing, although it was cooked to the desired doneness. However, it lacked the rich, meaty flavor one expects from high-quality meat.

The staff emphasized that the meat was supposed to be of high quality. We didn't feel that way.

The service was very attentive and friendly.

Unfortunately, the food wasn't good enough to make us want to come back.

Die Sitzgelegenheiten waren sehr einfache Holzklappstühle, wie man sie von früher kennt,  der rundeTisch war etwas klein.

Wir wurden sehr freundlich empfangen.

Als Gericht wählten wir das Entrecote Steak 300 g mit Pommes, da uns die anderen 4 Hauptgerichte nicht überzeugten.

Die Pommes waren selbstgemacht und schön kross, die gewählte Pfeffersosse schmeckte auch gut. Vom Steak hätte ich mir mehr erwartet bei einem Preis von 46 Euro. Uns fehlte die Finesse, auch eine liebevollere Anrichtung hätten wir uns gewünscht.

Das Steak lag allein auf dem Teller, und sah ohne Garnitur eher lieblos aus,  es hatte aber die gewünschte Garstufe. Uns fehlte jedoch der gute Fleischgeschmack, wie man ihn von hochwertigen Produkten kennt.

placeAddress: MASTAN, Gneisenaustraße 67, 10961 Berlin, Germany
text:
Mastan might just be the most Parisian restaurant in Berlin. It's the kind of place that makes you want to slow down, order another glass, and stay until they start stacking chairs. Solo dining at the bar turned out to be the perfect way to experience it.

I started with saucisson, olives and bread alongside a glass of Saint Cosme Côtes-du-Rhône 2023, and it was one of those moments where simplicity becomes a statement. Peppery, flavourful sausage, a proper baguette, briny bitter olives and a wine that tied it all together - quality ingredients doing what quality ingredients do. It's the kind of opener that reminds you how far great produce takes you.

The main was the same philosophy applied to steak with béarnaise, side salad and crispy potatoes. Sounds straightforward, and it is but the execution was flawless. The meat was juicy and deeply flavourful, and even the fat trim, which I usually leave on the plate, was genuinely DELICIOUS. The béarnaise had exactly the right acidity and tarragon balance. The potatoes were crisp and properly salted. Eight out of ten restaurants serve some version of this dish. Very few nail it like this.

I finished with a Jurançon - less sweet and more elegant than your typical dessert wine - followed by a double espresso and a small calvados. Unhurried, indulgent, exactly right.

The service has a distinct French quality to it, staff switching between French among themselves and accented English with guests. It adds to the atmosphere rather than detracting from it and the attention was warm without being intrusive. The room itself is intimate and genuinely romantic - there are outdoor tables that looked equally charming - but the bar works brilliantly for solo dining too.

If I lived in Berlin, I'd be a regular. Since I don't, I'll be back the next time I'm in town regardless. For anyone who appreciates classical French cooking done without shortcuts, Mastan earns every visit.
Compliments to the management, the service staff and the chefs.

placeAddress: My Tibet Haus, Proskauer Str. 10, 10247 Berlin, Germany
text:
Response to owner's comment:

1.) We presented the NeoTaste coupon as usual before ordering, so this explanation for the incorrect billing is invalid. Regardless of whether your POS system works differently than on the moon or Mars: My coupon says 30%, you only charged 10%, the discussion with your employee was pointless, and the free dessert now offered with the next order doesn't cover this either...

2.) The sanitary ware in your restroom is damaged. This has nothing to do with daily cleaning; it needs to be replaced, see other posts.

My original review:

We used the NeoTaste discount app, which Tibethaus registered with automatically. Upon registration, the waitress immediately became annoyed. When we received the bill, the coupon (30% off everything) was ignored, and instead, only two appetizers were arbitrarily deducted, which effectively amounted to only a 10% discount. When we inquired about it, she curtly dismissed us in English. Honestly: Anyone who doesn't want to participate in these kinds of programs shouldn't offer them in the first place!

Unfortunately, the food was only mediocre. The dal portion was very small, the momos were okay, but nothing special, and the salad smelled slightly musty. The absolute low point, however, was a foreign object in the food: We found a cut-off corner of a Tetra Pak carton in one of the dishes! The restroom was… very unpleasant, see other reviews. Absolutely not recommended.
originalText:
Antwort auf Inhaber-Reaktion:

1.) Wir haben den NeoTaste-Gutschein wie üblich vor der Bestellung gezeigt, also ist diese Begründung für die falsche Abrechnung hinfällig. Egal ob Ihr POS anders funktioniert als auf dem Mond oder dem Mars: Mein Gutschein sagt 30%, Sie berechnen nur 10% ab, die Diskussion mit Ihrer Mitarbeiter hat auch nichts gebracht, eine nun angebotene gratis Nachspeise bei der nächsten Bestellung deckt dies auch nicht ab...

2.) In Ihrer Toilette ist die Sanitärkeramik beschädigt, das hat nichts mit der täglichen Reinigung zu tun, sondern müsste ersetzt werden, siehe andere Beiträge.

Mein original Review:

Wir haben die Rabatt-App NeoTaste benutzt, bei dem sich das Tibethaus eigenständig registriert hat. Bei Anmeldung damit hat die Kellnerin direkt genervt reagiert. Als wir die Rechnung erhalten haben wurde der Coupon (30% auf alles) ignoriert und stattdessen willkürlich nur zwei Vorspeisen abgezogen, was am Ende effektiv nur 10% Rabatt entsprach. Auf Nachfrage blockte sie schnippisch auf Englisch ab. Ganz ehrlich: Wer an solchen Programmen nicht teilnehmen möchte, sollte sie gar nicht erst anbieten!

Leider war auch das Essen nur Mittelmaß. Die Dal-Portion war sehr klein, die Momos okay, aber keine Erleuchtung, und der Salat roch leicht muffig. Der absolute Tiefpunkt war jedoch ein Fremdkörper im Essen: Wir haben eine abgeschnittene Ecke von einer Tetrapackung in einem der Gerichte gefunden! Die Toilette war… sehr unangenehm, siehe andere Bewertungen. Absolut keine Empfehlung.
ownerResponseText:
Thank you for your feedback. We are sorry that your visit did not meet your expectations.

Regarding NeoTaste: Ideally, the voucher should be presented before ordering so that we can adjust the bill correctly. Unfortunately, subsequent changes are only possible to a limited extent in our POS system. However, we should have explained our limitations more clearly.

Regarding hygiene: Our restaurant and restrooms are thoroughly cleaned daily before opening. During normal restaurant hours, however, it can unfortunately happen that a guest leaves the restroom in a less than ideal condition shortly before. Since our restroom is also accessible to people who are not dining with us, it is additionally more difficult for us to check it multiple times a day. Nevertheless, we take your feedback seriously and will continue to pay close attention.

We would be delighted if you would visit us again. We would be happy to treat you to a complimentary Nepalese chai or dessert on your next visit.

Your Tibethaus Team
ownerResponseOriginalText:
Vielen Dank für Ihr Feedback. Es tut uns leid, dass Ihr Besuch nicht Ihren Erwartungen entsprochen hat.

Zu NeoTaste: Idealerweise sollte der Gutschein vor der Bestellung gezeigt werden, damit wir die Rechnung direkt korrekt anpassen können. Nachträgliche Änderungen sind in unserem Kassensystem leider nur eingeschränkt möglich. Dennoch hätten wir unsere Einschränkungen selbstverständlich besser und klarer erklären sollen.

Zum Thema Hygiene: Unser Restaurant sowie die Sanitärbereiche werden täglich vor der Öffnung gründlich gereinigt. Während des laufenden Restaurantbetriebs kann es jedoch leider vorkommen, dass ein Gast die Toilette kurz zuvor in keinem guten Zustand hinterlässt. Da unsere Toilette auch Personen offensteht, die nicht bei uns essen, ist es für uns zusätzlich schwieriger, sie jederzeit mehrfach am Tag zu kontrollieren. Trotzdem nehmen wir den Hinweis ernst und werden weiterhin aufmerksam darauf achten.

Wir würden uns sehr freuen, wenn Sie uns noch einmal besuchen. Gerne laden wir Sie bei Ihrem nächsten Besuch auf einen nepalesischen Chai oder ein Dessert aufs Haus ein.

Ihr Tibethaus-Team

text:
Truly typical Nepalese/Tibet experience: authentic music and staff, unique dishes. I had jasmine sauce for the first time, and it reminded me of the green medicine my mother gave me as a child for bronchitis. They say that when food evokes childhood memories, it's something truly special.

The chili on the table was barely spicy, more acidic than spicy. Please change that!

The Sherpa tea, which was supposed to be similar to Yogi Tea, was far too sweet for my taste. Even though it's authentic, it's undrinkable for me, and I do enjoy sweet tea and coffee.
originalText:
Wirklich typisch Nepal/Tibet, authentische Musik und Personal, einzigartige Speisen, Jasminsauce hatte ich zum ersten und erinnerte mich an grüne Medizin, die mir meine Mama als Kind bei Bronchitis gegeben hat und man sagt doch, wenn man Kindheitserinnerungen beim Essen hat, ist es was Einzigartiges und Besonderes.

Das Chili auf dem Tisch war fast gar nicht scharf, eher säuerlich, bitte ändern!

Der Sherpa-Tee, der ähnlich wie Yogi-Tee sein sollte, war mir persönlich viel zu süß. Auch wenn es authentisch ist, für mich nicht trinkbar, und ich trinke auch schonmal Tee oder Kaffee süß.

text:
The food was fantastically excellent, and the place itself was actually ok (although nothing special). The service was polite and accommodating, so everything was fine.....

But... The toilet conditions were incredibly poor, and therefore significantly detracted from the overall experience.

I don't think I'll come back and eat there unless I'm sure the toilets have been renovated.

I've taken a few pictures, which hopefully help explain the problem.

In the men's room, one of the urinals was out of order (of course, it could have just happened, but not the impression you got). The toilet was running so hard that you couldn't flush the toilet properly. The guest before me had clearly tried, but without success. The walls were painted over with graffiti (which can be considered decoration), but it helped to give a quite unhygienic picture of the conditions.

Thanks for the experience, but no thanks. Unfortunately, the worst experience with The Fork we've had to date 🫣
originalText:
Maden var fantastisk glimrende, og selve stedet egentligt også ok (om end noget specielt). Betjeningen var høflig og imødekommende, så alt fint.....

Men... Toiletforholdene var utrolig ringe, og trækker altså voldsomt ned på helhedsoplevelsen.

Jeg tænker ikke at jeg kommer tilbage og spiser, med mindre jeg er sikker på at toiletterne er blevet renoveret.

Har taget et par billeder, som forhåbentlig hjælper med at forklare problemet.

Hos herrerne, var det ene pissoir ude af drift (kunne naturligvis lige være sket, men ikke det indtryk man fik). Toilettet løb så voldsomt med vand, at man ikke kunne trække ordentligt ud i toilettet. Gæsten før mig havde tydeligvis forsøgt, men uden held. Væggene var overmalet med grafitti (hvilket kan betragtes som dekoration), men det var med til at give et ganske uhygiejnisk billede af forholdene.

Tak for oplevelsen, men nej tak. Desværre den dårligste oplevelse med The Fork vi har haft til dato 🫣

text: The place is dirty and smells of fried food. The staff didn't know what wines they had. The food was mediocre and sloppy. The marinated anchovies seemed to have been served straight from the can—all stuck together, dry, and without even a drizzle of olive oil. The tuna meatballs were so dry they fell apart when touched with a fork, and the patatas bravas, baked instead of fried as they should be, were stale and soggy. But the worst part of the experience was when a man who seemed to be the owner came in, sat at the bar with his feet up, and, along with a child, started handling and cutting the ham and eating it directly without even washing their hands, right in front of all the customers. Seeing this, we asked for the bill and left. My wife and I, who have both worked in the food industry for over 20 years in Berlin and other cities in Europe and America, have never seen anything like it. A terrible oversight.
originalText: El lugar es sucio y huele a fritura el servicio no sabía de los vinos que tenían la comida es mediocre y descuidada los boquerones en vinagre los parecían servidos directamente del de la lata todos pegados entre sí  y secos y sin ni siquiera un poco de aceite de oliva para disimular, las albóndigas de atún estaban tan secas que se desmoronaban al tocarlas con el tenedor y papas bravas echas al horno en ves de fritas como deben ser estaban añejas y blandas. Pero lo peor de la experiencia fue cuando un señor que parecía el propietario entró al local, se sentó en la barra con los pies sobre la banca y junto con un niño empezaron a manipular y cortar el jamón y comiéndolo directamente sin ni siquiera lavarse las manos y frente a todos los clientes.  Al ver esto pedimos la cuenta y nos marchamos. Yo y mi mujer que ambos trabajamos en gastronomía desde más 20 años en Berlín y otras ciudades de Europa y América no hemos visto una cosa así nunca. Un terrible descuido.
ownerResponseText:
Thank you for your feedback. We regret that your experience was not to your liking.

We are surprised by your description of your visit. At our establishment, we take great care in the quality of our products and hygiene standards, something our regular customers are well aware of. Regarding the presence of a child: our bar is a place where families are welcome and children are welcome.

We also appreciate all comments and opinions. We will continue working to offer the best possible experience to our visitors.
ownerResponseOriginalText:
Gracias por su comentario. Lamentamos que su experiencia no haya sido de su agrado.

Nos sorprende la descripción que hace de su visita. En nuestro establecimiento cuidamos la calidad de los productos y las normas de higiene con mucha atención, algo que nuestros clientes habituales saben bien. Respecto a la presencia de un niño: nuestro bar es un lugar donde las familias son bienvenidas y los niños pueden estar.

Agradecemos igualmente todos los comentarios y opiniones. Seguiremos trabajando para ofrecer la mejor experiencia posible a quienes nos visitan.

placeAddress: Clandestino | Tapas & Wein, Waldemarstraße 29, 10999 Berlin-Bezirk Friedrichshain-Kreuzberg, Germany
text: Interesting to see previous reviews as we had the same experience: back in 2022 the food was just amazing! The change they apparently had really put a toll on the dishes. We had the olives, pan con tomate, baby squid, eggplant, artichokes and patatas bravas. We cannot recommend any of them and will unfortunately not come back. The food does not have much to do with Spanish food - we lived in Madrid some years. I hope the kitchen will improve and therefore give the following tips: pan con Tomate as tapas is served in Catalonia differently and not just crated tomato on baguette with a bit of salt. The artichokes were from the glass with a mustard sauce - did not taste, maybe tried the typical grilled artichoke hearts with olive oil and lemon. Also the eggplants were finely sliced, put in batter and fried. You can offer so much more with this great vegetable! This should not even be a dish how it was served. You can contact me at any time.

Sincerely,
Isaac

Wieder mal ein Beweis dafür, dass Leute sich nur in solchen Situationen Zeit dafür nehmen.
Danke nochmal.

text:
I came for a good Gricia and left already planning my next visit.

La Lupa was one of the best Italian meals I’ve had in Berlin. The menu celebrates Roman cuisine in the best possible way: simple, authentic and packed with flavour. Every dish felt like it had a story behind it, and most importantly, it tasted exactly how it should. I was lucky to try the traditional Gricia with a Kik of Italian black truffle: JUST WOW!

The cocktails were also a wonderful surprise—creative, refined and made with real attention to detail.

What made the experience even better was the service: warm, relaxed and genuinely welcoming. Like home ❤️

If you’re looking for trendy Italian food, there are plenty of places in Berlin.

If you’re looking for a real Roman osteria, go to La Lupa.

text: We had made a reservation just to be sure, but it definitely wasn’t needed. It did get busier later in the evening, but there were still a few tables free. The menu is pretty small, around 8 options for pasta and similar for the antipasta. Both antipasta dishes were really good, but the bruschetta was a bit salty. I personally like salty food so it wasn’t too bad.  The main dishes were absolutely amazing. The pasta was perfectly cooked and the sauces tasted great. placeDescription: Relaxed restaurant serving elevated traditional Italian cuisine amid understated surrounds.
text: I can only echo the other reviews... First, the time slot we were assigned – you know the drill. Then, the wine list arrives first, even though we don't yet know what we're going to order. Only after that does the food menu appear. We had opted for one of the four rosés in the mid-price range of €50. Apparently, it wasn't available, but they offered a recommendation from outside the other three wines on the menu, which then cost an additional €25. Since all four of us ordered the set menu (plus an extra €6 for each of us), I can comment on the same starters and main courses for everyone. The tarte tatin had charred onions from the grill and some yellow, wilted lettuce leaves. The main course had an overly salty sauce (fish and seafood), and the dessert was accompanied by what looked like an ice cream from a wholesaler. In short, a lot of hype, exorbitant prices for mediocre food, and subpar wine service. That's it.
originalText: Ich kann mich den Kritiken eigentlich nur anschließen... Zunächst das Zeitfenster, das uns zugewiesen wurde,, kennt man ja schon. Wir hatten uns für einen (von Vier) Rosée im mittleren Preissegment von 50 € entschieden. Den gab es wohl nicht, dafür aber eine Empfehlung außerhalb der anderen 3 Weine auf der Karte, der dann gleich 25 € mehr kostete. Da wir alle Vier das Menü bestellten (plus 4x6€ Extrakosten obenauf, kann ich für alle die gleichen Vor - und Hauptspeisen besprechen. Tarte Tatin mit vom Grill angekohlten Zwiebeln und teils gelben welken Salatblättern, der Hauptgang mit völlig übersaltzener Sauce (Fisch und Meeresfrüchte) und auch ein Eis wohl aus dem Großmarkt als Beigabe am Dessert. placeDescription: Relaxed restaurant serving elevated traditional Italian cuisine amid understated surrounds.
text:
Yesterday we went to Heiliger Teufel in Kreuzberg for Restaurant Week.

I had Wellington with asparagus and ham as a starter, ravioli with Parmesan fondue on carpaccio as a main course, and panna cotta with mango and coconut for dessert. My girlfriend had stracciatella with tomatoes and mole sauce, fettuccine Alfredo with green asparagus and truffle, and the same panna cotta.

The dishes were all very well thought out and delicious, especially the ravioli, which were incredibly rich. The portions were the perfect size; we were completely satisfied.

The only downside: Since we were the first guests, we were served the Prosecco from the previous evening. The bottle was half empty when it was poured and completely empty after we finished, so there weren't many bubbles left. These things happen!

In total, we paid €130, which is great for a lovely evening with a three-course meal.

Still, 5/5. We'll definitely be back.
originalText:
Wir waren gestern im Heiligen Teufel in Kreuzberg bezüglich der Restaurant Week.

Ich hatte Wellington mit Spargel und Schinken als Vorspeise, Ravioli mit Parmesanfondue auf Carpaccio als Hauptgang und Panna Cotta mit Mango und Kokos als Dessert. Meine Freundin Stracciatella mit Tomaten und Mole Sauce, Fettuccine Alfredo mit grünem Spargel und Trüffel, sowie die gleiche Panna Cotta.

Die Speisen waren alle sehr durchdacht und lecker , besonders die Ravioli waren unglaublich stark. Die Portionen waren größentechnisch perfekt, wir wurden richtig satt.

Einziger Kritikpunkt: Da wir die ersten Gäste waren, bekamen wir den Prosecco vom Vorabend. Die Flasche war beim Einschenken halbleer und nach uns komplett leer, somit waren relativ wenig Bubbles noch drin. Kann passieren!
Insgesamt haben wir 130 € gezahlt, was für einen schönen Abend mit 3 Gänge Menü super ist.

Trotzdem 5/5. Wir kommen gerne wieder.

text:
The food was delicious; it felt like being back in Thailand 🇹🇭.

The boat noodle soup was very tasty and a little spicy. It wouldn't be spicy in Thailand 😅.

The back section has a terrace that's lovely for enjoying the fresh air in this weather.

I did find one of the servers a bit unfriendly, though. I'd already sat down when she asked if I wanted to sit at the singles table (by the aisle). I said no. She made a face and looked grumpy. That was unnecessary and kind of spoiled the moment. The restaurant wasn't full at the time. The rest of the service was excellent, though.

I highly recommend it.

text:
Fantastic Thai food with an amazing vibe!
Maiyarap Berlin is a must-visit if you are craving authentic Thai flavors in the city. The crispy pork belly is absolutely incredible, it makes for a perfect starter or a phenomenal topping to mix into their soups.
Make sure to check out the leafy back garden if you can; it is a beautiful, peaceful little oasis that completely cuts out the street noise while you eat. Just a quick heads-up: they do not hold back on the heat here, and the spice levels can get pretty intense. If you aren't sure, definitely start with a lower spice level. Overall, amazing food, great atmosphere, and highly recommended!

text:
If you're looking for hospitality and good pizza, this isn't the place for you. The pizza was disappointing, and the service was even worse.

I work in the restaurant industry myself and understand that sometimes things can take longer. We waited over 60 minutes for our pizza without a single update. When we tried to calmly bring it up, the owner immediately took it personally, turned around, and walked away. I even followed him into the shop to try and talk to him, but he simply ignored me and acted as if I wasn't there. Instead of an apology or a normal conversation, we were attacked.

If only the pizza had tasted good. The dough was sticky and made with spelt flour. The crust wasn't fully cooked in the middle, but it was already burnt on the outside and bottom.

Mistakes happen, but disrespect is a choice.
originalText:
Wer Gastfreundschaft und gute Pizza sucht ist hier falsch. Die Pizza war enttäuschend, der Umgang noch mehr.

Ich arbeite selbst in der Gastro und habe Verständnis dafür, dass es mal länger dauern kann. Wir haben über 60 Minuten auf unsere Pizza gewartet ohne eine einzige Info. Als wir das ruhig ansprechen wollten, fühlte sich der Besitzer sofort persönlich angegriffen, drehte sich um und ging weg. Ich bin ihm sogar in den Laden gefolgt, um das Gespräch zu suchen, er ignorierte mich einfach und tat so, als wäre ich nicht da. Statt einer Entschuldigung oder einem normalen Gespräch wurden wir angegangen.

Wenn wenigstens die Pizza gut geschmeckt hätte. Der Teig war pappig und aus Dinkelmehl. Der Pizzarand war innen noch nicht ganz durchgebacken, jedoch von außen und unten schon schwarz.

Fehler passieren, aber Respektlosigkeit ist eine Entscheidung.
ownerResponseText:
We are sorry that your visit went as planned. As a small, family-run business, treating our guests with respect is very important to us.

Our restaurant was fully booked that evening, which unfortunately led to longer waiting times. We apologize for this. However, we remember the rest of the evening differently than it has been described here.

We are particularly disappointed that we were unable to find a solution together on the spot. In our opinion, an open conversation would have been more helpful to both of us than this situation.

We wish you all the best nonetheless.
ownerResponseOriginalText:
Es tut uns leid, dass ihr euren Besuch so erlebt habt. Gerade weil wir ein kleiner Familienbetrieb sind, liegt uns ein respektvoller Umgang mit unseren Gästen sehr am Herzen.

text:
I still can’t believe I found this extraordinary slice of Parma in Kreuzberg. After living in Italy, I have high standards for pizza — and Parma di Vinibenedetti genuinely feels like being back in Italy.

The pizza is easily one of the best I’ve had in Berlin.. anywhere in Germany! You can taste the quality of the organic ingredients and the care behind the traditional Italian preparation. The authentic sourdough dough is exceptional — light, flavorful, with the perfect balance of crunch and chew.

It is worth returning here again and again not only for the food. The atmosphere is warm, authentic, genuine.  Si mangia proprio bene — you really eat well here. The wine selection is also excellent! Especially the cold white wine on a hot summer day…

If you are in Berlin and looking for authentic Italian pizza, high-quality organic ingredients, and a genuinely special restaurant experience in Kreuzberg, we highly recommend Parma di Vinibenedetti. Without exaggeration, one of the best pizzas I’ve had in Germany. Divine — and I will absolutely be back.
ownerResponseText:
Thank you so much for these incredibly kind words ❤️

Reading reviews like yours is one of the most rewarding parts of what we do. We put a lot of care into our organic ingredients, our sourdough, and creating a place that feels genuinely Italian, so it means a lot to hear that it brought you back to your time in Italy.

We're especially happy that you enjoyed the pizza, the atmosphere and the wine selection. Moments like a cold glass of white wine and a good pizza on a warm Berlin evening are exactly what we hope to share with our guests.

We can't wait to welcome you back to our little corner of Parma here in Kreuzberg. Until then, grazie mille! 🍕🍷✨

text:
I've been wanting to try Goldies for quite some time. I'm in Berlin pretty often, and their smash burgers always looked insane. Especially the caramelization on the patties. I had to see what the hype was about.

I visited the Kreuzberg location and ordered the Super Smash TS Double as a menu.

First of all, the fries. I honestly don't think I've ever had better fries in my life. They were absolutely insane. Every single one was perfectly crispy, well seasoned, and just ridiculously good. Easily the highlight of the meal.

The burger itself was a bit more disappointing. The patties were perfectly caramelized, exactly as advertised. The bun was nice too, just a simple potato bun that did its job.

The problem for me was the overall bite. I love smash burgers, but this happens to me quite often with smash burger places. You take a bite and everything just turns into one big mix. The flavors are good, but there isn't much separation of textures. Everything kind of blends together. I even ended up adding a bit of salt myself.

I honestly don't know what the solution is. Maybe something crunchier, maybe bigger tomato slices, maybe just playing around with the toppings a bit more. But I never really got to appreciate the beautifully caramelized patties because everything became one soft bite.

The ordering process is also very McDonald's-ified, if that's even a word. Self-ordering screens, very streamlined, just a more premium version of fast food. And I respect that. They're obviously running a large operation and doing it well.

So for me, this lands at 4 out of 5. The quality is clearly there, and those fries alone are worth coming back for. The burger just wasn't as interesting as I had hoped.

text:
Some of the best pasta in Berlin!

Most importantly, no standard German spiciness, but an Arrabiata that finally lives up to its name.

The pasta cime di rapa (only available seasonally during the first quarter) and the truffle pasta are also highly recommended.

Of course, the atmosphere is typical of a market hall: crowded, loud, and hectic, and rather uncomfortable and stressful, especially during peak hours.

But that's just how it is in a market hall, and you get used to it very quickly.

The place is fantastic, and you should definitely check it out!!

The owner, Angelo, is also a great guy, always friendly, and makes fantastic pasta!

I love coming here, and the prices are absolutely reasonable.

You can even buy the pasta to take home.

Salvatore always makes the pasta fresh, and you can tell the quality even when you make it yourself at home.

Nevertheless, you should definitely try it there as well!

I've been coming back for six years because I just can't get enough of this pasta.

It's simply an experience! ✨

i Tan Yu Xiu,

text:
This place absolutely deserves five stars.

We had the vegetarian red curry with grilled pointed cabbage, which was simply outstanding. The balance of flavors was incredible: rich, fresh, beautifully spiced, and deeply aromatic. We also ordered the pepper leaf wraps, which were absolutely delicious.

But the real highlight was the banana blossom salad. Easily one of the best Thai dishes I’ve ever had. Every dish looked stunning and tasted even better. Every bite was a little explosion of flavors.

text:
We visited this restaurant expecting a good Thai meal, but unfortunately the experience didn’t live up to the price.

When we arrived, the person at the register wasn’t very customer-service oriented. I asked which curry was the most traditional, and the response was simply that they “don’t have such a thing,” which wasn’t very helpful.

We ordered two main dishes, and the total came to around €50. The first dish was a green curry, but it was so spicy that I couldn’t really appreciate the flavors. The second dish was the mussels, and disappointingly, they seemed to be prepared with essentially the same green curry sauce.

We also ordered two side dishes—the pickled onions and the pickled cucumbers. Both portions were quite small and underwhelming.

Overall, for the price, I expected better service, more variety in the dishes, and a better balance of flavors. If you enjoy extremely spicy food, your experience may be different, but based on our visit, I wouldn’t recommend this restaurant.

text: I came here hoping for tacos, not a crash course in Middle Eastern politics. Whatever your political views may be, I’d really appreciate being able to sit down, order a meal, and enjoy it without being greeted by political messaging. Restaurants are one of the few places where people from all backgrounds should be able to relax over good food. The food may well be excellent, but the atmosphere made me feel less like a customer and more like I was expected to pass some kind of ideological test before ordering. I just wanted tacos—not a lecture on international diplomacy
ownerResponseText:
Hi!
Interesting. We don't really give political lectures at the restaurant, even though our staff might be more than capable to do so, we only have a couple of stickers around to show solidarity. However, I can lecture you here (for free) about politics and how food fits into that category though.

Food is inherently political. Cuisines are a structural part of cultures and national identity.
Whether we like it or not, the decisions we make are inherently political, even something as trivial as picking a restaurant to go eat. 

When you enjoy a dish at your favorite restaurant you are not only tasting the ingredients, you are experiencing hundreds of years of knowledge passing throughout generations in the kitchen. You're experiencing more than 500 years of history: the mixed of two worlds and all the struggle involved.

 Today, Mexico is a country whose culture is growing in popularity and we are very proud of how we are representing it. That being said, Mexico is a country with a troubled history. A country which has been invaded, occupied and got more than half its territory stolen. As such, we will always show our support for the oppressed because we understand their history and present as ours too.

Have a nice day.

text:
I’ve been eating here for years and their ramen is one of the best.

But on my last visit I was truly sad to see that they served our gyoza deep fried with sweet chili sauce. When we asked for black vinegar they could not even provide it. It was not even busy, they could’ve easily pan-fried them.

The deep fried gyoza was one of the reasons why I left Cocolo ramen and happily moved to Mori Mori where the quality of the ramen is sooo much better and the gyoza was still pan-fried. (Not sure when they started to deep fry them)

Deep fried Gyoza, especially served to Asian customers, feels like a middle finger in the face. It’s a sign that the restaurant is cutting corners. And sweet chili sauce is reserved for pre-frozen mass produced deep fried eggrolls. It just shows a lack of respect for your own dish.

You guys can do much better! At least the Ramen was still on point.

Would’ve given you 5 stars if it weren’t for the double blasphemy.

text:
I recently visited Wen Cheng at Görlitzer Park. After all the hype surrounding the restaurant, the overall experience was unfortunately a real disappointment.

The Food
The noodles were okay, but nothing special. Given the restaurant's reputation, I expected significantly more depth and flavor. It's decent, but it doesn't justify the hype for me.

Service & Atmosphere
The real weak point, however, was the staff. The service seemed extremely unmotivated, distant, and simply unfriendly. From the very beginning, I felt more disturbed than welcome. Customer service should definitely be different.

Conclusion
Good food is one thing, but when the service is so unenthusiastic and the food can't live up to the hype, it simply doesn't cut it. I won't be returning.
originalText:
Ich war vor Kurzem bei Wen Cheng am Görlitzer Park. Nach all dem Hype um das Restaurant war das Gesamterlebnis leider eine echte Enttäuschung.

​Das Essen
Die Nudeln waren geschmacklich okay, aber absolut nichts Besonderes. Bei dem Ruf, der dem Laden vorauseilt, hätte ich deutlich mehr Tiefe und Geschmack erwartet. Es ist solide, rechtfertigt aber den Wirbel darum für mich nicht.

​Service & Atmosphäre
Der eigentliche Schwachpunkt war jedoch das Personal. Der Service wirkte extrem unmotiviert, distanziert und schlichtweg unfreundlich. Man hatte von Anfang an das Gefühl, eher gestört als willkommen zu sein. Kundenservice geht definitiv anders.

​Fazit
Gutes Essen ist das eine, aber wenn der Service so unlustig ist und das Essen den Hype nicht halten kann, reicht es schlichtweg nicht. Für mich wird es keinen weiteren Besuch geben.
ownerResponseText:
Hello Domenik,

Thank you for taking the time to describe your visit in such detail. We are sorry to hear that your experience with us at Görlitzer Park was so disappointing.

We take your feedback regarding the service very seriously. We want our guests to feel welcome and well cared for, and your impression of unmotivated and unfriendly service does not reflect the standards we set for our team.

We also acknowledge your assessment of the noodles. Tastes naturally vary, but we regret that our cuisine did not meet your expectations after the hype surrounding Wen Cheng.

If you are willing to give us another chance, we would appreciate it if you could email us at maii.hamada@wenchengnoodles.com and let us know the date and approximate time of your visit. This will allow us to see who was serving that day and discuss your feedback directly with the team.

Thank you again for your candid feedback.

Warmest regards,

Wen Cheng Team 🥢

vielen Dank, dass du dir die Zeit genommen hast, deinen Besuch so ausführlich zu schildern. Es tut uns leid zu hören, dass dein Erlebnis bei uns am Görlitzer Park so enttäuschend für dich war.

Wenn du bereit bist, uns noch eine Chance zu geben, würden wir uns freuen, wenn du uns unter maii.hamada@wenchengnoodles.com schreibst und uns das Datum sowie ungefähr die Uhrzeit deines Besuchs mitteilst. text:
I ordered a chicken and halloumi sandwich from Sahara Imbiss and, frankly, I'm extremely disappointed. The biggest problem is the bread: it crumbles so badly while eating that the entire contents keep falling out. It's practically impossible to eat the sandwich properly. Instead of a quick snack, you end up with more ingredients on your hand or plate than in the bread.

What's particularly annoying is that this problem apparently isn't new. It's been mentioned several times, yet nothing seems to be changing. There's no sign of improvement.

Overall, it unfortunately seems like little attention is paid to quality and care during preparation. A sandwich should at least be assembled in such a way that you can eat it without it falling apart. I find this completely unacceptable and therefore a very disappointing experience. I definitely can't recommend it.

text:
We ordered three appetizers. The Neapolitan croquette had clearly been fried more than once: dry and inedible. The montanare were overall decent.

The Aperol Spritz, on the other hand, was practically water: flavorless and completely unbalanced.

Then the pizzas arrived. Three were burned, one to the point of being inedible, so we asked for it to be remade. The other two were half burned. My advice is to lower the oven temperature when the restaurant is empty and increase it during busy periods. The dough might be good, but unfortunately, overcooking completely ruins the product.

The most disappointing thing was the service. The waitress asked us if everything was okay, and we pointed out that the pizzas were burned. She saw with her own eyes that most of it was left on the plate and told us she'd charge us 50% for the pizzas.

When we got the bill, however, we found everything at full price. This is not appropriate behavior. Don't mock your customers. Not all of them are tourists, and even if they were, they still deserve respect and honesty.

A huge disappointment.
originalText:
Abbiamo ordinato tre antipasti. Il crocchè napoletano era chiaramente stato fritto più di una volta: secco e immangiabile. Le montanare erano tutto sommato discrete.

L’Aperol Spritz, invece, era praticamente acqua: senza sapore e completamente sbilanciato.

Poi sono arrivate le pizze. Tre erano bruciate, una al punto da essere immangiabile e abbiamo chiesto di rifarla. Le altre due erano bruciate per metà. Il consiglio che posso dare è di abbassare la temperatura del forno quando il locale è vuoto e aumentarla nei momenti di maggiore affluenza. L’impasto sarebbe anche buono, ma purtroppo la cottura rovina completamente il prodotto.

La cosa più deludente è stata il servizio. La cameriera ci ha chiesto se fosse andato tutto bene e le abbiamo fatto presente che le pizze erano bruciate. Ha visto con i propri occhi che gran parte era rimasta nel piatto e ci ha detto che ci avrebbe fatto pagare le pizze al 50%.

Al momento del conto, però, abbiamo trovato tutto a prezzo pieno. Questo non è un comportamento corretto. Non si prendono in giro i clienti. Non tutti sono turisti e, anche se lo fossero, meritano comunque rispetto e onestà.

Una grande delusione.

Restaurant Richard in Kreuzberg is a beautifully decorated restaurant with wooden ceilings, lovely pictures, and very attentive service.

The menu is concise and offers an exquisite selection. For example, the wild broccoli or artichoke appetizers are highly recommended, as is the tuna salad, which is of exceptional quality. Main courses include dishes such as Yuj ige duck or turbot meunière, with a choice of sides, such as roasted polenta or rosemary potatoes. For dessert, there's pavlova or goat cheese crème brûlée. text:
Delicious spot to try authentic Turkish manti inside Markthalle Neun in Kreuzberg. I had been looking forward to visiting this place for a while and it definitely lived up to expectations.

There were two options for the manti, one filled with beef and one with spinach and cheese. I went for the beef version and it was excellent. According to my Turkish friend it looked and tasted like the real deal, which says a lot. The dumplings were soft and flavorful, and the yoghurt combined with the paprika butter sauce was seriously addictive.

If you are exploring Markthalle Neun, this is definitely one of the food stalls you should not miss.

text:
Cozy artistic café with delicious sandwiches and a friendly atmosphere
A small, cozy, and artistic café that instantly makes you happy. Open weekdays from 08:00–18:00 and on weekends from 09:00–18:00 — perfect for breakfast, coffee breaks, and long lunch moments.

The sandwiches, soups, pastries, coffees, and teas are all delicious and made with care. A nice detail: large pitchers of water that you can help yourself to, without the modern “€2.50 for tap water” surprise.

Cool art hangs on the walls, making the whole place even cozier, and the service is friendly and relaxed — exactly what you hope for in a neighborhood café like this.

In short: a warm, creative place where you’ll love to linger. ☕🎨🥪

De broodjes, soepen, zoetigheden, koffies en thee zijn allemaal heerlijk en met zorg gemaakt. Een fijn detail: grote kannen water die je zélf mag pakken, zonder de moderne “€2,50 voor kraanwater”-verrassing.
Aan de muren hangt toffe kunst die het geheel nog gezelliger maakt, en de bediening is vriendelijk en ontspannen — precies zoals je hoopt in zo’n buurtcafé.
Kortom: een warme, creatieve plek waar je graag blijft hangen. ☕🎨🥪

text: The Spreewirtschaft in Berlin offers a solid culinary experience, especially if you enjoy hearty dishes. I went there with friends for my birthday, and the food was generally very tasty – the veal schnitzel was particularly noteworthy, as it was enormous and incredibly delicious. The lamb was also excellent, although the portion was unfortunately quite small, which was a bit disappointing – prior notification of this would certainly have been helpful. While the service was always attentive, it was somewhat impersonal. The ambiance, however, left something to be desired: the music was barely audible, and the lighting was far too bright, creating a lack of a cozy atmosphere. Overall, it's a good restaurant, but with a few minor flaws in its overall design.
originalText: Die Spreewirtschaft in Berlin bietet eine solide kulinarische Erfahrung, besonders wenn man auf deftige Gerichte steht. Zu meinem Geburtstag war ich mit Freunden dort, und das Essen war insgesamt sehr lecker – das Kalbsschnitzel war besonders hervorzuheben, denn es war riesig und unglaublich lecker. Auch das Lamm war geschmacklich hervorragend, allerdings war die Portion leider sehr klein, was uns ein wenig enttäuschte – eine vorherige Info dazu hätte sicher geholfen. Der Service war zwar immer aufmerksam, aber etwas kühl. Das Ambiente ließ allerdings zu wünschen übrig: Die Musik war kaum hörbar und das Licht viel zu grell, was eine gemütliche Atmosphäre vermissen ließ. Insgesamt ein gutes Restaurant, aber mit kleinen Schwächen in der Gesamtgestaltung.

ownerResponseText:
Thank you for your honest feedback. We are truly sorry that your visit was so disappointing. Such behavior should, of course, not occur and does not meet the standards we set for our service.

We are especially sorry that you weren't even able to try our food. When you're looking forward to a visit, you should feel welcome from the very beginning.

We take your feedback very seriously and will address this internally. Thank you for taking the time to share your experience so openly.

We would be delighted if you would give us another chance sometime so that we can show you a better side of ourselves next time.

Danke dir für dein ehrliches Feedback. Es tut uns wirklich leid, dass ihr bei eurem Besuch so einen enttäuschenden Eindruck hattet. So ein Verhalten sollte natürlich nicht vorkommen und entspricht nicht dem Anspruch, den wir an unseren Service haben.

Besonders schade finden wir, dass ihr unser Essen dadurch gar nicht erst probieren konntet. Gerade wenn man sich auf einen Besuch freut, sollte man sich von Anfang an willkommen fühlen.

Wir nehmen deinen Hinweis sehr ernst und werden das intern ansprechen. Danke, dass du dir die Zeit genommen hast, uns das so offen zu schildern.

placeDescription: German classics & Austrian dishes, plus cocktails, served in a relaxed, convivial setting.
text:
While searching for a nice restaurant near Uber Square, we ended up here. The ambiance was pleasant, and our reserved table was free.

The two servers seemed slow and awkwardly disorganized, even though the restaurant was still quite empty. The menu sounded appealing, promising hearty and delicious dishes.

Unfortunately, the fresh bread and garlic butter served beforehand were the best things about the meal.

The meatballs on roasted potatoes with chanterelles (€24.50) turned out to be meatballs that resembled Swedish meatballs more than anything else. The roasted potatoes were meager, consisting of pale, discarded slices, and the chanterelles were freezing cold. We complained, and after what felt like an eternity, the plates returned, now lukewarm. The hottest thing about the dishes was definitely the plates.

My husband had ordered the beef goulash with mashed potatoes. The mashed potatoes were almost liquid (they actually came with a spoon), and the goulash was a tiny blob with a whopping 3 tablespoons of flour! Diced meat on top. And all for the exorbitant price of €21.50.

In conclusion: The ambiance is very pleasant, the service could be improved, and the food is absolutely not worth the price, which we pointed out. But nobody seemed to care. Presumably, they're only catering to walk-in customers from the hotel across the street.

Not recommended.
originalText:
Auf der Suche nach einem schönen Restaurant am Uber Platz sind wir hier gelandet. Das Ambiente angenehm, reservierter Tisch war auch frei.
Die beiden Servicemitarbeiter schienen uns langsam und unbeholfen-unkoordiniert, obwohl es noch recht leer war. Die Speisekarte las sich fein-deftig und anregend.
Das frische Brot und die Knoblauchbutter vorab waren aber leider das Beste am Menü.
Die Buletten auf Röstkartoffeln mit Pfifferlingen (24,50 €) entpuppten sich als Fleischklopse, die eher Köttbullar ähnelten. Die Röstkartoffeln dürftig und blasse abgezählte Kartoffelscheiben, die Pfifferlinge total kalt. Wir reklamierten und nach einer gefühlten Ewigkeit kamen die Teller zurück, nun lauwarm. Das heißeste an den Gerichten waren tatsächlich die Teller.
Der Mann hatte das Rindergulasch mit Stampfkartoffeln gewählt. Der Kartoffelbrei fast flüssig (dazu gabs tatsächlich einen Löffel), das Gulasch ein kleiner Klecks mit sage und schreibe 3! Fleischwürfeln obendrauf. Und das zum stolzen Preis von 21,50 €.
Fazit: Ambiente sehr angenehm, Service ausbaufähig, das Essen dem Preis absolut nicht angemessen, was wir auch sagten. Interessierte aber niemanden. Vermutlich ist man eh nur auf Laufkundschaft des umseitigen Hotels ausgelegt.
Nicht zu empfehlen.

placeAddress: Hühnerhaus Imbiss, Görlitzer Str. 31, 10997 Berlin, Germany
text:
I've known the chicken shop for a very long time... and have always been satisfied!

But what I got there on a Sunday around 4 pm was outrageous.

I'm mentioning the date deliberately because it already seemed strange to me that there was no one in line. And the weather was beautiful.

I bought two half-chickens to take away (€13)... Since I hadn't been there in a long time, I was really looking forward to it.

So, when I got home, I quickly tore open the bag and tried to take a half-chicken out... but I couldn't!


I couldn't get it out! The bones are supposed to separate from the meat, that's true...

...but it was so much more than that: You couldn't take out a single piece. Everything you touched crumbled between your fingers, which meant, among other things, that you also ended up with all the cartilage and small bones in your mouth... I was constantly spitting... and the breast was bone dry... I only ate half a chicken out of two because it was inedible, and thus wasted about €6.50... Even if sales are slow, I still expect good quality... In my opinion, they knew that when they packed it in my bag, because at home, you couldn't even recognize two halves anymore. It was simply a chicken mess!!!

What a shame, lost a long-time customer!!!
originalText:
Ich kenne das Hühnerhaus schon sehr lange... und war immer zufrieden!
Aber was ich an einem Sonntag um ca 16 Uhr dort bekommen habe war eine Frechheit.
Ich sage das mit dem Datum bewusst, weil es mir schon  komisch vorkam , dass niemand anstand. Bei super Wetter.
Ich habe mir 2 halbe Hähnchen zum mitnehmen (13 €)  gekauft...
Da ich lange nicht mehr dort war war die Vorfreude riesig.
Also zu Hause schnell die Tüte aufgerissen und wollte ein halbes Hähnchen aus der Tüte nehmen... es gelang mir nicht!
Die Knochen sollen sich ja vom Fleisch lösen, schon richtig...
...aber  es war weit mehr: Man konnte kein einziges Teil entnehmen alles was man anfasste  zerbröselte zwischen den Fingern, was unter anderem zu Folge hatte, dass man natürlich auch die ganzen  Knorpel und und kleinen Knochen mit im Mund hatte... man war  nur am Spucken... dafür war die Brust staubtrocken... ich habe gefühlt nur ein halbes Hähnchen, von zweien,gegessen weil es nicht genießbar war und somit   ca.6,50 € entsorgt...
Wenn der Abverkauf schleppend  läuft, erwarte ich trotzem eine gute Ware...meiner Meinung nach wussten sie das auch als man es mir in meien Tüte packte , denn zu Hause waren ja schon keine zwei Halbe mehr zuerkennen. Es war einfach nur ein Hüherhaufen!!!

Schade, langjährigen Kunden verloren !!!

ownerResponseText:
Good evening Mr. Schuler,

We are very sorry for your negative experience.

We work with Lieferando and unfortunately do not handle the delivery service ourselves… Therefore, we unfortunately do not always have control over the pickup time of our dishes.

You are welcome to contact Lieferando, and we are sure they will be able to accommodate you.

The gelatinous substance you described is potato starch. This gives the sauce a creamy consistency.

Guten Abend Herr Schuler,

text: Life on the Otto Bock Campus! Alongside the already established restaurants, a new player has emerged on the hilltop. This fantastic oriental restaurant has moved into the ground floor of a modern new building with exceptional, almost futuristic architecture. In my opinion, this has truly enriched the campus with a wonderful, spacious terrace. From the warm welcome and attentive service to the delicious food, it was a perfect dining experience. The ambiance is bright and airy, and features an open kitchen. All the staff and chefs appear extremely well-groomed and approachable. I find the concept of sharing dishes at the table with friends particularly brilliant. This allows you to enjoy trying many different delicacies that wonderfully stimulate the taste buds. The atmosphere and the team are simply fantastic. Keep it up!
originalText: Leben auf den Otto-Bock-Campus! Damit hat der Campus aus meiner Sicht eine echte qualitative Bereicherung mit einer tollen, großen Terrasse gewonnen.Vom herzlichen Empfang über den aufmerksamen Service bis hin zu den köstlichen Speisen war es ein perfektes Gasterlebnis. Das Ambiente ist hell, luftig und punktet mit einer offenen Küche. text:
Even though many say the new location is even better than the previous ones, I honestly miss the very special charm of the small restaurant in Charlottenburg. Back then, it felt like visiting a real hidden gem. The place was tiny, highly sought after, and that's precisely what made a visit so special.

Today, the restaurant is significantly larger – and unfortunately, you can tell by the service. It's by no means bad, but the personal and warm atmosphere of the past has been somewhat lost, in my opinion.

The menu remains exciting, creative, and varied. There really is something for everyone, and that's exactly what makes the concept so special. One minor criticism, however, is the portion sizes: some dishes are surprisingly small for the price, while others are considerably more generous and even seem cheaper. These discrepancies aren't always easy for me to understand.

Nevertheless, I wouldn't want to miss this restaurant in Berlin. It stands out from many others, has a unique character, and remains a place I'm always happy to recommend. It no longer quite earns a perfect score from me, but it's definitely worth a visit.
originalText:
Auch wenn viele sagen, dass der neue Standort noch besser ist als die früheren, vermisse ich ehrlich gesagt den ganz besonderen Charme des kleinen Restaurants in Charlottenburg. Damals hatte man das Gefühl, einen echten Geheimtipp zu besuchen. Der Laden war winzig, heiß begehrt und genau das machte den Besuch zu etwas Besonderem.

Heute ist das Restaurant deutlich größer – und leider merkt man das auch beim Service. Er ist keineswegs schlecht, aber die persönliche und herzliche Atmosphäre von früher ist für mich etwas verloren gegangen.

Die Speisekarte ist nach wie vor spannend, kreativ und abwechslungsreich. Hier findet wirklich jeder etwas, und genau das macht das Konzept so besonders. Ein kleiner Kritikpunkt sind allerdings die Portionen: Manche Gerichte sind für den Preis erstaunlich klein, während andere deutlich üppiger ausfallen und sogar günstiger wirken. Diese Unterschiede sind für mich nicht immer nachvollziehbar.

Trotzdem möchte ich dieses Restaurant in Berlin nicht missen. Es hebt sich von vielen anderen ab, hat einen ganz eigenen Charakter und bleibt eine Adresse, die ich immer wieder gerne empfehle. Für die volle Punktzahl reicht es für mich zwar nicht mehr, aber ein Besuch lohnt sich definitiv.

text:
I have very mixed feelings about Osman's Daughters; the decor and location are beautiful. We didn't feel particularly welcome, and it was a real shame that the service seemed rather curt and brusque overall. We were very disappointed to learn that the set menus are only available for groups of four or more, which is precisely why we wanted to go there. This information was clearly missing beforehand. The food itself was beautifully presented, and all the dishes tasted really good, but I would still describe it as slightly overpriced. I also didn't quite understand why the two dips meant for sharing with three people only included two tiny crackers or a small piece of bread. Mezze culture aside, at this price point, a small piece of bread and crackers for each person at the table should be standard. We ended up having to order extra bread so we wouldn't just eat the dip by the spoonful – which is, of course, a clever way to generate additional sales. As for the still water, I'm pretty sure it was tap water; I don't know if it's worth charging so much for it.


I also didn't quite understand why the two dips meant for sharing with three people only included two tiny crackers or a small piece of bread. Overall, it seems to me that you're aiming for fine dining, but a few things are still missing for it to be perfect. It's a shame, I would have loved to find my new favorite neighborhood restaurant here. Perhaps you could take the recurring criticisms to heart and improve your performance a bit.
originalText:
Sehr gemischte Gefühle über Osmans Töchter, die Einrichtung und die Location ist wunderschön. So richtig willkommen geheißen fühlten wir uns nicht, sehr schade war auch dass der Service insgesamt eher kurz angebunden und ruppig wirkte. Sehr enttäuscht waren wir darüber dass die Menüs erst ab 4 Leuten möglich sind, deswegen wollten wir eigentlich dort hin gehen. Mir hat diese Information im Vorfeld deutlich erkennbar gefehlt. Das Essen an sich war sehr schön präsentiert und alle Gerichte schmeckten auch wirklich gut, trotzdem würde ich sie als leicht überteuert bezeichnen. Ich habe auch nicht ganz verstanden warum in den beiden Dips zum Teilen für 3 Personen nur zwei winzige Cracker waren, oder ein kleines Brot. Mezze- Kultur hin oder her, in der Preisklasse sollte für jeden am Tisch ein eigenes kleines Brot und Cracker selbstverständlich sein. Wir mussten dann extra Brot bestellen um den Dip nicht einfach pur zu löffeln, das ist natürlich auch eine clevere Methode um Zusatzverkäufe zu machen. Beim stillen Wasser bin ich mir recht sicher dass es sich um Leitungswasser handelte, weiß ich nicht ob man dafür soviel Geld verlangen muss.
Insgesamt wirkt es mir so dass hier gehobene Gastronomie angestrebt wird, aber ein paar Dinge noch zur Vollendung fehlen. Schade, ich hätte hier gerne mein neues Lieblingsrestaurant in der Nachbarschaft gefunden. Vielleicht nehmt ihr euch mal die wiederkehrenden Kritikpunkte zu Herzen und steigert eure Performance somit noch ein bisschen.

text:
Love letter for this restaurant:
Everything was exceptionally well prepared. As a guest, I felt in very good hands. Service was on point and quick at a busy hour. The food was fine-dining quality coming from a Turkish person I think the menu was very worked on and exquisite. Choice of herbs and flavours was next level. A little bit of fusion for Turkish cuisine is almost never practically handled this good. We had Manti, vine leaves, mütebbel, osmans kebap, mücver, layered phyllo and pastirma. For the dessert we were not hoping for much from a meze bar but we were never been this wrong! Shahmaran’s corek was delicious highly recommend. Thank you for this experience, cannot wait to come back!

text:
Absolutely disappointing and unfortunately not recommended at all.

We had reserved a table for 20 people well in advance and were all looking forward to the evening. Planning is especially important with such a large group.

Then, an hour before our reservation, the table was suddenly canceled – without any explanation or apology. When we inquired on-site, the staff couldn't or wouldn't provide a plausible reason. Instead, they offered only contradictory and unconvincing excuses, such as the boss having made a decision.

Canceling a reservation of this size at such short notice is extremely unprofessional and disrespectful to the guests. Finding an alternative for 20 people within an hour is nearly impossible.

This is simply no way to treat customers. We will definitely not be returning and, after this experience, unfortunately cannot recommend this establishment.
originalText:
Absolut enttäuschend und leider überhaupt nicht zu empfehlen.

Wir hatten lange im Voraus einen Tisch für 20 Personen reserviert und uns alle auf den Abend gefreut. Gerade bei einer so großen Gruppe ist Planung wichtig.

Dann kam eine Stunde vor unserem Termin plötzlich die Stornierung – ohne jegliche Begründung oder Entschuldigung. Als wir vor Ort nachgefragt haben, konnten oder wollten die Mitarbeiter keinen nachvollziehbaren Grund nennen. Stattdessen gab es nur widersprüchliche und wenig glaubwürdige Ausreden wie, dass der Chef etwas entschieden habe.

Eine Reservierung in dieser Größenordnung so kurzfristig platzen zu lassen, ist extrem unprofessionell und respektlos gegenüber den Gästen. Innerhalb einer Stunde findet man für 20 Personen kaum noch eine Alternative.

So geht man mit Kunden einfach nicht um. Wir werden definitiv nicht wiederkommen und können den Laden nach dieser Erfahrung leider nicht empfehlen.

text: A nice tapas stand in the trendy Markthalle 9. The selection is manageable, offering cold tapas as well as small items fresh from the grill. Like the other stands, it's self-service, and afterwards you can find a cozy spot in this symbol of Kreuzberg's gentrification. Otherwise, the beautiful hall probably wouldn't have survived... In any case, my small mixed tapas plate with salami, cheese, olives, and bread, as well as the accompanying red wine, were delicious. For €7.50 you can certainly get more, but considering the lovely atmosphere, the price is reasonable. I'll gladly come again.

ownerResponseText:
Dear Pia,

We are so sorry that your experience at the Summer Bake Sale didn't meet your expectations. Our cake sale ran all day from 11 am to 7 pm and was one of the busiest days we've ever had at our bakery. We understand that you expected more cake when you arrived, and that's exactly what we wanted to offer our guests. However, since the cakes sold out very quickly, we were constantly baking new ones, and perhaps you arrived at an inconvenient time.

We are also sorry that you didn't enjoy the taste. All of our cakes are vegan, many are gluten-free, and they are baked the same day using the freshest ingredients. We received great feedback about our cakes throughout the day, so it's a shame that you didn't like them.

C+ is a small business with only one chef and one barista, so we can't offer the experience of a large buffet with many cooks and servers working behind the scenes.


C+ is a small business with only one chef and one barista, so we can't provide the same atmosphere as a large buffet with many cooks and servers working in the background. We value Slow Food and community engagement, which is why we organize cake sales where people can sample our cakes at a huge discount. Multi-tiered cakes are difficult to offer at such events, as they are more elaborate and expensive to make, but the flavors and fillings are the same.

We would love for you to visit our bakery again so we can make it up to you. Perhaps this time you'll try our famous cinnamon rolls or a delicious drink :)
ownerResponseOriginalText:
Liebe Pia, 
es tut uns sehr leid, dass deine Erfahrungen beim Summer Bake Sale nicht deinen Erwartungen entsprochen haben. Unser Kuchenverkauf fand den ganzen Tag von 11 bis 19 Uhr statt und war einer der geschäftigsten Tage, die wir je in unserer Bäckerei hatten. Wir verstehen, dass du bei deiner Ankunft mehr Kuchen erwartet hast, und genau das wollten wir unseren Gästen auch bieten. Da die Kuchen jedoch sehr schnell nacheinander ausverkauft waren, haben wir ständig neue gebacken, und vielleicht bist du zu einem ungünstigen Zeitpunkt gekommen. 

Es tut uns leid, dass Ihnen auch der Geschmack nicht gefallen hat. Alle unsere Kuchen sind vegan, viele davon glutenfrei und werden am selben Tag aus den frischesten Zutaten gebacken. Wir haben den ganzen Tag über großartiges Feedback zu unseren Kuchen erhalten, daher ist es schade, dass sie Ihnen nicht geschmeckt haben. 

C+ ist ein kleines Unternehmen mit nur einem Küchenchef und einem Barista, daher können wir nicht das Gefühl eines großen Buffets mit vielen Köchen und Servierkräften im Hintergrund vermitteln. 
Wir legen Wert auf Slow Food und den Austausch mit der Gemeinschaft, deshalb organisieren wir Kuchenverkäufe, bei denen die Leute unsere Kuchen zu einem enormen Rabatt probieren können. Mehrstöckige Torten lassen sich bei einer solchen Veranstaltung nur schwer anbieten, da ihre Herstellung aufwendiger und teurer ist, aber die Geschmacksrichtungen und Füllungen sind dieselben.

Wir würden uns sehr freuen, wenn du wieder in unserer Bäckerei vorbeischaust, damit wir es wieder gutmachen können, vielleicht probierst du dieses Mal ja unsere berühmten Zimtschnecken oder ein leckeres Getränk :)

text:
No Tip, No Peace – Beware the Italian Drama!

I visited this place with a friend for an Espresso Martini and loved the vibe, so I booked a window table for 10 to celebrate my 40th birthday a month later.
Everything seemed fine until the bill came. While chatting with friends, I casually placed my card on the terminal to pay my Espresso Martini, and suddenly, a rude tall dark haired Italian waiter SHOUTED at us, accusing us of not tipping—even though we were still seated, enjoying our drinks. He even had the audacity to say he hoped I'd leave a tip on my birthday. Shocked, I calmly told him this wasn’t the way to earn one...

Two weeks later, I popped in for a drink to get a feel for the place. Lorenzo, the manager, was friendly and reassured me the window table would be ready for my birthday. So, I kept the reservation and forgot about the italian drama boy.

The night before my birthday, I called to confirm—only to be met by the same waiter. When I reminded him it was for my birthday, he smugly said, "I remember you for not tipping," then casually told me he’d erased my booking and suggested I find another place. He told me to complain to the managers if I wanted. Some people really do use the little power they have to feel important in life.

I was worried I wouldn’t find a table last minute, but I got lucky. We managed to snag a big table at "Mariona," an amazing Catalan restaurant nearby, and had the best birthday I could’ve hoped for!
But I felt the call to write this review as Its important to share how bad the service was.

text:
I feel the need to write this review because although the environment is wonderful, vibes are great and the ambiance is super fun and cozy, my group and I had an awful experience with one of the waiters here. The service for the evening was fine, nothing special. But when it came time to pay the bill, the waiter, who is Italian, tall with dark hair,  stood over me as I paid with card and said “In Germany, we have to pay tip.” I wasn’t planning on tipping since all I ordered was a glass of Prosecco, and service was just ok, but he stood over me making me feel uncomfortable and waiting for me to change my mind. Eventually I said ok, I guess I’ll add a tip, and I did. He was incredibly rude and intimidating as he did this and it made me feel really uncomfortable. He then did the same thing to my friend. I will not be returning to this place, even though it’s a lovely vibe.

Also, my same friend wanted to have her birthday party in this space and was willing to look past this uncomfortable moment with the waiter because it really is a nice environment. She was given a reservation and then the day before the party, the same waiter said he remembered her from our table, and that her reservation was canceled. She had to find somewhere else last minute for 10+ people which is not easy. There is something very off with this person who works there and I do not advise people to go to this place.
